name: Black Claw Stout
summary: Beneath Stormwind, Zardeth of the Black Claw prepares a drink for Lord Wishock. The stout reaches him as an ordinary tavern beverage.

sections.title: A Toxic Draught
sections.body: Below the Slaughtered Lamb's taprooms, Zardeth of the Black Claw works beyond the city guard's notice. Lord Wishock threatens again and again to shut the operation down, though his bar tabs upstairs go unpaid. So Zardeth turns the noble's weakness for strong drink against him. He hides a lethal dose in a common tavern refreshment.

sections.title: Quiet Assassination
sections.body: In Stormwind Keep's Hall of Petitioners, Lord Wishock receives the stout. His pompous pride and thirst make him eager to accept what he mistakes for a servant's attentive offering. He drinks it on the spot. The poison acts almost at once, silencing one of the cult's most persistent political critics beneath the Royal Court's very noses.

faq.answer: Zardeth of the Black Claw concocts Black Claw Stout in the catacombs beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter for Lord Wishock.

faq.q: Who is the target of the stout?
aliases: who dies from black claw stout
faq.answer: Lord Wishock is the target, a high-handed noble in the Hall of Petitioners who campaigns to shut down the warlock haven while drinking there on credit.
Zardeth of the Black Claw brews the stout in the crypts beneath the Slaughtered Lamb.

faq.q: Why is Lord Wishock offered the stout?
faq.answer: Zardeth sends Lord Wishock the stout in the Hall of Petitioners, asking the courier to see how the noble likes his special brew.

angles.text: For Stormwind's hidden warlock coven, carrying the brew is an errand. A meddling noble wants its haven beneath the Slaughtered Lamb shut down.
Carrying the brew into Stormwind Keep brings the warlocks beneath the Slaughtered Lamb close to the capital's nobles.
